format: JSONL records preserve packet_hex, sparse [band,block,raster_index,signed_value] tuples, dense signed16LE coefficient bytes, packed scratch image bytes, counts, raw, used_bytes, and hashes. New actual rows carry source cohort/fid/plane/chunk/ordinal/key plus packet and coefficient hashes.
scope: Actual related V88 corpus chunks and synthetic/directed legacy rows only; no new gameplay was captured.

selection.method: Complete actual V88 corpus scan. Select source identities containing the maximum single-chunk packed scratch bytes, BR88 packet bytes, sparse-write count, nonzero AC count, or block count. Include every chunk in all three planes for each selected frame, deduplicating source tuple (cohort,fid,plane,chunk) against earlier selections and the frozen V91d rows. No timing or fitted metric is used.
